values.note: A permit and reservation are always required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/weiser/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: The pin is on Weiser State Forest's Port Clinton Tract (Oaks Road off PA 61 north of Hamburg), which has three drive-in roadside sites: PC002 (pull-in, 81-ft gravel driveway, site 104 ft), PC003 (back-in, 50-ft driveway at a severe grade) and PC004 (back-in, 27-ft driveway). None lists a max vehicle length and all three are filed under Tent Site only. The tract also has PC001 (hike-in, tent only) and PCG001, a walk-to site recommended for group camping. Up to 10 people per site.

sites.source: ReserveAmerica site pages for parkId 880253, siteId 23653/23654/23655/23666/23656 ('Driveway Entry: Pull-In' / 'Back-In', 'Driveway Length: 81/50/27', 'Driveway Grade: Severe' (PC003), 'Looking For Category: Tent Site', 'Site Access: Walk-To' and 'This campsite is recommended for group camping' (PCG001), 'Max Num of People: 10', 'take Oaks Road at the entrance of the Weiser State Forest, Port Clinton Tract') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/weiser/camping ('There are 17 designated motorized, roadside campsites available on four Weiser State Forest tracts'), read 2026-10-20

note: Weiser State Forest's Port Clinton Tract, on Oaks Road off PA 61 north of Hamburg, in wooded upland: three drive-in motorized roadside sites (PC002-PC004) plus a hike-in and a walk-to group site, reserved through the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests system. No water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 570-875-6450. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, reservation always required (fcfs never), and the pin's tract (Port Clinton: three drive-in roadside sites, no max vehicle length published). Note corrected: designated roadside sites, not dispersed camping. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate; no year-round statement (the booking site says only 'Open through Dec 31 2026').
flags: Name: a generic 'Weiser State Forest' entry; its pin sits on the Port Clinton Tract (Oaks Road, ~600 m from PC001). The booking site's campground is 'Weiser State Forest' (parkId 880253), sites PC001-PC004 and PCG001 on this tract.

Missing phone: Weiser State Forest district office 570-875-6450. Website: the forest page is official; the camping page https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/weiser/camping and https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880253 are more specific.

Criteria (fit): none of the Port Clinton Tract's drive-in sites lists a Max Vehicle Length and all are 'Looking For Category: Tent Site' only (PC002 pull-in with an 81-ft driveway; PC003 back-in 50 ft at a severe grade; PC004 back-in 27 ft); the one site listing RV/Trailer (PCG001, 51 ft) is walk-to and recommended for group camping.
